_note: Paths a guide describes, and how far each has been tried. `automated`: automated tests exercise it (against stand-ins for outside services). `handTested`: a person has tried it for real; then `evidence` is the record's address. A guide lists ids under `checks` in public-pages.json, and its page shows one badge each. When a hand test is logged, set handTested to true and fill in evidence.

google-sign-in-live.label: sign-in with a live Google account

microsoft-sign-in-live.label: sign-in with a live Microsoft account

lets-encrypt-live.label: Let's Encrypt with a real certificate authority

container-upgrade.label: updating a v0.2.3 container to v0.3.0 with its data

windows-update-button.label: the Windows update button from v0.2.3

generic-oidc-live.label: sign-in with a live OpenID Connect provider such as Keycloak

two-host-live.label: two hostnames with a real domain and proxy

phone-reach-live.label: opening the console and Workbench from a phone

workbench-rollback.label: going back to v0.2.3 by restoring Workbench's copy
